Нужны адрес модема, пароль штатного Web,:
Preparation needs the modem address, the stock Web password, a separate agent password and a USB data cable. Check connections only probes access; Connect selects SSH or available USB ADB. A separate preliminary preparation button enables ADB and installs components. The application takes a local lock and checks pending operations.

Over HTTP /ubus/, it requests zte_web_sault, hashes the password with SHA-256, then hashes that value with the challenge. The resulting hash is sent to web_login. An incorrect password stops preparation; no other passwords are tried automatically. The application reads the IMEI and both firmware versions, requests and downloads a fresh encrypted settings backup, and verifies identity again. The original, identity.json and SHA-256 are saved locally in SetupBackups/<UUID>. This is a settings backup, not a full flash image.

Checking working ADB or SSH does not require decrypting the backup. The backup-key suffix is used only for the B31 restore path. Passwords and the Web session are omitted from progress logs.
2. Если SSH или ADB уже работает: 2. If SSH or ADB is already working
Сначала проверяется существующая установ:
The existing SSH and agent installation is checked first. Success requires a trusted host key, root access and matching modem identity. Once readiness is confirmed, preparation finishes without enabling ADB again or reinstalling the existing agent. Resuming an earlier installation also requires checking its journal.

If SSH is not ready, the bundled adb runs devices -l. Device, offline, unauthorized and permission states are distinguished. When the usb: descriptor is absent, as can happen on Windows, adb -d get-serialno must identify the same single USB device. Network ADB and emulators are not treated as USB modems. Commands through adb -s <serial> shell then verify root, ARM64, CID, firmware hashes and stock Web identity. The modem must match the intended target.

When ADB is ready, all activation methods are skipped. The application checks the installer profile and continues with SSH/agent installation. An absent usb: field or unavailable SSH alone does not cause a backup restore.
Для ранних прошивок сначала включите гал:
For earlier firmware, first enable Skip firmware check: normal preparation is verified for B31. This option does not authorize installing components on unsupported firmware. When no matching ADB device is found, the application queries zwrt_bsp.usb methods through JSON-RPC list. The stock method is eligible when set declares a mode parameter. If introspection itself is unavailable, one fallback attempt is allowed only for the historically known CN MU5250 family through B27. An explicit method list without set skips this method. A similar-looking firmware name does not authorize the B31 restore path on unknown firmware.

The Web identity is checked again and intent is saved in setup-pending.json before sending zwrt_bsp.usb.set {"mode":"debug"} exactly once. Switching USB composition may disconnect USB networking; using the modem Wi-Fi can keep Web reachable. This method itself neither uploads a backup nor requests a reboot.

Accepted, rejected and unconfirmed replies are logged separately. For up to 90 seconds, the application checks for actual root USB ADB on the same modem; RPC status 0 alone is not readiness. An interrupted request is not automatically sent again. If ADB does not appear, only B31 can proceed to restore, after logging into Web again, verifying the same device and taking a new backup. If Web does not return, preparation stops.
4. B31: включение через бэкап и перезагр: 4. B31: enabling ADB through backup and reboot
Этот способ применяется только к провере:
This path is restricted to the verified MU5250 B31 profile when working ADB has not been confirmed. A fresh archive is decrypted in memory using the IMEI and backup-key suffix. OpenSSL Salted__, nested gzip/tar files, MD5, member names and metadata are checked. Only the line below is added immediately after #!/bin/sh in etc/rc.local. Other entries are preserved and compared with the original. The result is repacked, encrypted and decrypted again for verification.

Before upload, back_parameter.adb-only is saved and the Web device is checked again. The CGI uploader must confirm the SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes. Identity is checked once more, restore-requested is persisted, and device_restore_proc is called once. The modem restores settings and reboots, interrupting connectivity. The application waits up to four minutes for USB ADB and verifies root and identity. An accepted restore request alone does not complete preparation.

If the original rc.local already contains the line, the backup is not restored again: actual ADB access is checked and its absence explained. An adbd process can run while USB remains in normal networking mode; the process alone is insufficient. A lost restore reply never triggers another automatic restore. Resume uses the saved journal and device checks; an installer that may already have run is not blindly started again either.
«Не обнаружен»: проверьте USB-кабель дан:
Not detected: check the USB data cable and port; on Windows, also check the Android ADB driver in Device Manager. A charging-only cable is insufficient. Unauthorized: the device is visible but has not granted debugging access; confirm a prompt on the modem if one is shown. Offline: a transport exists but shell is not responding; reconnect the cable and check again. Missing permissions, failure to start local adb and remote command failures are reported separately. The application does not install drivers or disable driver signature enforcement.

If USB ADB sees a device but root, architecture or the intended modem identity cannot be confirmed, a successful connection is not reported and diagnostics retain the reason. All these checks must pass before the installer is transferred. When multiple matching devices are connected, the first serial is not selected arbitrarily. Installation requires matching IMEI/versions and CID. Each shell call must return a separate remote exit marker: local adb exit code 0 cannot hide a failed modem command.

ADB access and installer compatibility are checked separately. SSH/agent installation supports exact B31 and experimental B02 hashes. The stock method may enable ADB on earlier firmware, but unsupported installation stops with a message about unsupported firmware or diag-router. Skipping the general firmware check does not remove installer restrictions. B31 restore is not used for B02 or unknown firmware. Factory passwords, fac_open and hidden factory methods are not tried automatically.
